title: Nepal floods: Everest veterans join Rasuwa tunnel rescue, battle thick sludge, debris
description: Highly trained mountain guides and Everest veterans joined flood rescue efforts in Nepal's Rasuwa district.  Specialist teams used expedition skills to access disaster zones where roads had disappeared.  Rescuers entered a mud-choked hydropower tunnel, pushing approximately 120 meters inside.  They recovered a camera bag and determined excavation equipment was needed for deeper access.  The rescue operations aimed to locate workers trapped in multiple hydropower tunnel systems.

title: 'Slippages reveal design flaw on Kanpur-Lucknow e-way'
description: Slippages on the Kanpur-Lucknow Expressway suggest design issues, not construction defects.  Affected stretches will require rebuilding from the ground up, officials stated.  A preliminary investigation identified weak, plastic soil as a primary cause.  Poor drainage also contributed to the expressway's structural problems.  The government awaits a final report on the detailed investigation.

title: Travis Kelce adds college sports and MLB to his $200M business empire
description: Travis Kelce is building a business empire that extends well beyond his NFL career. The Chiefs star has interests in Garage Beer, valued at around $200 million, Sleep Number and 1587 Prime, alongside a new NIL venture called TEKTA. He has also joined the ownership group of the Cleveland Guardians, adding MLB to his expanding portfolio. Kelce's moves show a clear focus on investments, ownership and businesses that can outlast his football career.

title: BJP-SAD alliance revival gains ground ahead of Punjab polls
description: The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal may revive their alliance for upcoming Punjab assembly elections. Both parties acknowledge this partnership as their strongest option despite seat-sharing disagreements. Talks have intensified since Prime Minister Narendra Modi met SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal recently. The BJP seeks a larger seat share and greater government role, reflecting its increased vote share.

title: Congress & BJP clash over Haldwani ‘purification’ row, Rahul seeks FIR

Both parties exchanged accusations regarding caste divisions and past incidents.

title: August rainfall fails to reduce India's monsoon deficit
description: India's cumulative monsoon rainfall deficit remains despite August's better-than-expected rains.  This deficit has caused a significant acreage gap in kharif crop sowing.  Paddy and maize acreage have both reported notable declines compared to last year.  Erratic rainfall distribution prevented increased acreage for most kharif crops.  Several states, including Bihar and Andhra Pradesh, face substantial rainfall deficits.

title: FSSAI bans Everest, LG from selling hing
description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has issued prohibition orders against two spice companies.  Everest Food Products and Laljee Godhoo and Company faced these orders for non-compliance issues.  Samples of compounded asafoetida and hing powder did not meet alcohol-soluble extract requirements.  Earlier reviews also found violations in other masala products from Everest.  These actions highlight ongoing food safety scrutiny within the Indian market.

title: Man on Phuket-B’luru flight tries to hide drugs in overhead panel, held
description: A passenger flying from Phuket to Bengaluru allegedly tried to hide narcotics. He attempted to conceal thirteen packets of contraband substance in an overhead panel. The passenger then discarded some of the substance into the lavatory bin. Upon landing in Bangalore, customs officials arrested the individual at the aerobridge. Air India Express is cooperating with authorities in the ongoing investigation.

Their combined wealth also represents long-term business opportunities, investments and financial security.

title: Travis Kelce makes $200 million business move inspired by his childhood

The move has a personal connection for the Kansas City Chiefs star, who grew up in Ohio near Cedar Point and has long loved theme parks. The investment comes as the company faces financial challenges, while Kelce continues building interests beyond football, including Formula 1 and brand partnerships.

title: Meta explored 60% layoffs in plan hatched at Zuckerberg's Hawaii compound
description: Meta explored cutting some teams by up to 60% and handing their work to AI agents under a plan code-named Project OT. Hatched at Mark Zuckerberg's Hawaii retreat, it involved two layoff waves, pods of three replacing traditional teams, and keystroke tracking to train AI models. Staff revolted, internal sentiment fell from 74% to 55%, and Meta's own data showed the AI wasn't delivering promised productivity gains.
